layout_strategies.hero: Split layout: Left content (Headline, Subhead, CTA), Right image (Hero Image). On mobile, stack with image on top or as background with overlay.
layout_strategies.services: Grid layout (1 col mobile, 2 col tablet, 4 col desktop). Cards with icon/image on top, title, description, price.
layout_strategies.gallery: Masonry or Bento grid. Mix of landscape and portrait images. Lightbox on click.
layout_strategies.booking: Two-column layout on desktop: Left side contact info/map, Right side booking form card.
layout_strategies.footer: Simple, centered or 3-column. Darker background (#3E2723) with light text (#FFCCBC).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a 'LanguageContext' to manage global language state (FR/EN).
Use the specified color palette strictly. Avoid default Tailwind grays.
Ensure the Booking Form captures: Name, Phone, Email, Pet Type, Service, Date/Time, Notes.
The Booking Form should NOT require a backend. Log submission to console and show a success toast.
Use 'sonner' for all notifications (booking success, errors).
Implement smooth scrolling for navigation links.
Ensure the Gallery has a lightbox feature (click to expand).
The 'Social' section should only link to Facebook as requested.
Use the 'Montserrat' font for all headings and 'Open Sans' for body text. Import them via Google Fonts in index.css.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles).
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry where possible.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Add micro-interactions to all buttons and cards (hover lift, shadow increase).
